# Operator script

1. `We had a spike of 403s on shop.example.com yesterday afternoon, starting around 13:40 UTC and lasting a bit over an hour. I want to know what was being blocked and whether real customers were affected. Fast mode please.`
2. (answer if asked for the timezone) `UTC.`
3. (answer if asked to approve a download that is within the limits) `Yes, go ahead.`
4. (answer if told a download is over a limit and asked how to proceed) `Don't override anything. Pick whatever fits within the limits.`
